title: disabled field label stays perceivable
rule: Disabled field: control disabled; label (and helper/validation) stay enabled so AT can still perceive them. Settings Save MAY disable until requireds are complete only with visible reason + this perceivable label (dual-cite with GOV.UK don’t-disable on public/question).
pass_when: Disabled control still has a perceivable (not disabled-away) label and helper/validation. If Settings Save is disabled, the reason is visible and the label stays perceivable.
fail_when: Disabled control whose label/helper/validation cannot be perceived; or disabled Save with no visible reason.
overview: A disabled field keeps its label and helper perceivable to assistive tech.
apply_when: Disabling Fluent fields or Settings Save until requireds are complete.
not_when: GOV.UK public question pages that generally avoid disabling submit.
agent_hint: Disable the control, not the label/helper; show why if Save stays disabled.
description: When a Fluent field is disabled, the control is disabled but the label (and helper/validation) stay enabled so assistive technology can still perceive them. Settings Save may disable until requireds are complete only with a visible reason and this perceivable label (dual-cite GOV.UK don’t-disable on public/question). Fail a disabled control whose label/helper cannot be perceived, or disabled Save with no visible reason.
